meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: free (free tier) / pay-as-you-go. status values: active (free tier) / pay-as-you-go. cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. specText summarizes the free allowance or prices in the official wording; durationText is the duration or billing form; limitsText states key limits; overageBehavior is the charging beyond the free allowance or beyond the stated rules; egressText states the egress rule; risks are notes; flags are English tags. Supabase Storage and Firebase Storage details are in the Databases section (data/database.json and the database detail pages), not repeated in this file.

offers.title: Cloudflare R2 free tier
offers.specText: Monthly: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A operations, 10M Class B operations, egress free; standard storage $0.015/GB-month; Class A $4.50/M requests; Class B $0.36/M requests
offers.durationText: Monthly-metered free allowance; permanence is not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pricing page — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Free allowance metered monthly; Infrequent Access is not covered by the free tier, 30-day minimum storage, data retrieval $0.01/GB; which operations fall under Class A and Class B — check the official page
offers.overageBehavior: Prices beyond the free allowance on the pricing page: standard storage $0.015/GB-month, Class A $4.50/M requests, Class B $0.36/M requests; Infrequent Access: $0.01/GB-month, Class A $9.00/M, Class B $0.90/M, data retrieval $0.01/GB
offers.egressText: No egress bandwidth charges for any storage class (official wording: There are no charges for egress bandwidth for any storage class.)
risks: The free tier does not apply to Infrequent Access
Infrequent Access has a 30-day minimum storage period
Infrequent Access data retrieval costs $0.01/GB
The free allowance is metered monthly
offers.sourceName: Cloudflare R2 official pricing page (page note: updated 2026-10-30)
offers.notes: The free-tier column for Infrequent Access reads NA in the billing examples; which operations Class A and Class B each include — check the official page.

offers.title: Backblaze B2 (pay-as-you-go)
offers.specText: Storage $6.95/TB/30 days; egress free up to 3x average monthly stored data, $0.01/GB beyond that; Overdrive $15/TB/month
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pricing page — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: No free tier; unlimited free egress via partner CDNs (Fastly, Cloudflare, bunny.net, CacheFly, CoreWeave, Equinix Metal, Vultr, phoenixNAP)
offers.overageBehavior: Egress beyond 3x average monthly stored data is $0.01/GB; storage billed at $6.95/TB/30 days
offers.egressText: Free up to 3x average monthly stored data, $0.01/GB beyond that; unlimited free egress via partner CDNs
risks: No free tier
Egress beyond 3x average monthly stored data is billed at $0.01/GB
Overdrive terms beyond the $15/TB/month price — check the official page
offers.notes: The official pricing page showed no “10GB free” wording in either of two captures; whether operation requests are billed separately — check the official page.

offers.title: Tigris free tier
offers.specText: Monthly: 5 GB Standard storage, 10,000 PUT/COPY/POST/LIST requests, 100,000 GET/SELECT and other requests, egress free; Standard storage $0.02/GB/month; Class A $0.005/1,000 requests; Class B $0.0005/1,000 requests
offers.durationText: Monthly allowance, resets monthly; whether it is permanent is not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
offers.cardNote: The official pricing page states “No card to start”.
offers.limitsText: The free allowance applies to Standard storage only; Infrequent Access has a 30-day minimum storage period and $0.01/GB retrieval; Archive and Archive Instant Retrieval have a 90-day minimum storage period; data in the Archive tier requires restoration before it can be accessed; storage is measured in binary gigabytes (1 GB equals 2^30 bytes), and GB/month is determined by averaging the daily peak storage over a billing period
offers.overageBehavior: Beyond the free allowance: Standard storage $0.02/GB/month, Infrequent Access $0.01/GB/month, Archive $0.004/GB/month, Archive Instant Retrieval $0.004/GB/month; Class A $0.005/1,000 requests, Class B $0.0005/1,000 requests; DELETE and CANCEL are free; object notifications $0.01/1,000 events; egress free
offers.egressText: Egress is free for all four storage classes (the Egress row of the official pricing table reads Free throughout)
risks: The free allowance applies to Standard storage only
Infrequent Access has a 30-day minimum storage period; deleting, updating, or transitioning objects early still incurs a 30-day charge
Archive and Archive Instant Retrieval have a 90-day minimum storage period
Data in the Archive tier requires restoration before it can be accessed, and is charged at the Standard storage rate for the restoration period
Storage is measured in binary gigabytes
offers.notes: The S3-compatible wording is on the Tigris official documentation partner integrations page. The free-tier block reads PUT, COPY, POST and LIST / GET, SELECT and all other requests; the documentation page groups them as PUT, POST, LIST / GET, HEAD — both wordings are shown side by side; check the official page.

offers.title: Google Cloud Storage free tier
offers.specText: Monthly: 5 GB-months of regional storage (US regions only), 5,000 Class A operations, 50,000 Class B operations, 100 GB of outbound data transfer from North America (excluding China and Australia destinations); only the us-east1, us-west1, and us-central1 regions, calculated combined
offers.durationText: The Free Tier has no end date; Google reserves the right to change or eliminate the offering with 30 days' advance notice; unused allowances do not roll over
offers.cardNote: A Google Cloud billing account is required to access the Free Tier; Free Trial signup requires a credit card or other payment method (a temporary $0.00–$1.00 hold, not an actual charge).
offers.limitsText: Free Tier benefits apply only to usage in the us-east1, us-west1, and us-central1 regions, calculated combined; the free outbound transfer covers North America to all region destinations excluding China and Australia; unused allowances do not roll over to the next month
offers.overageBehavior: Beyond the Free Tier, usage is billed at standard rates (paid billing account) or paid for by the $300 trial credit (trial billing account): Standard storage starting at $0.02/GiB/month, Nearline starting at $0.01/GiB/month, Coldline starting at $0.004/GiB/month, Archive starting at $0.0012/GiB/month, operation charges starting at $0.0004/1,000 operations, retrieval fees starting at $0.01/GiB, general data transfer starting at $0.08/GiB; full rates — check the official page
offers.egressText: 100 GB of outbound data transfer from North America per month is free (excluding China and Australia destinations); inbound data transfer is unlimited; data transfer within the same location is unlimited; beyond the allowance, general data transfer starts at $0.08/GiB
risks: Free Tier benefits apply only to three US regions
The free outbound transfer excludes China and Australia destinations
Unused allowances do not roll over
A Cloud Billing account is required to access the Free Tier
The $300 trial credit is valid for 90 days and is separate from the Free Tier
offers.sourceName: Google Cloud official Free Tier documentation
offers.notes: The Free Tier documentation writes 5 GB-months / 100 GB, while the product page pricing table writes 5 GiB of standard storage / 100 GiB of data transfer; both unit wordings are shown side by side. The product page pricing table also states no retrieval fee for standard storage and unlimited free operations. Which operations Class A and Class B each include is not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.

offers.egressText: Upload/download (egress) charging is not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
